The PPU alone, split out of the combined row above. NASA NEXT-C: 34.5 kg of PPU at 7.4 kW = 4.66 kg/kW (The NEXT-C Power Processing Unit, Aerojet/NASA 2020).  The paper gives the PPU's OUTPUT as 0.5-7 kW; 7.4 kW is the input at full power, so this is per kW of input, as the unit says. The other half — the thruster head — scales with THRUST and is per-technology, because that is exactly where a pulsed plasma thruster and a gridded ion engine stop being interchangeable.
